key.name: autopush
key.description: When enabled, password-store commits are pushed after each change.

key.name: store-dir
key.description: Directory containing the password-store git repository.

key.name: branch
key.description: Local branch the app pushes to and reads history from. When empty, the working tree's current branch is used.

key.name: autoload
key.description: When enabled, encrypted entries are loaded into the in-memory cache after the vault opens.

key.name: show-group-view
key.description: When enabled, the vault tree shows groups only and selected groups open an entries pane.

key.name: interpret-multiline-as-markdown
key.description: When enabled, multiline fields are rendered as Markdown in read-only mode.
